decision.observed_event: Nothing on the table proves it. The game stops while every face at the table turns to you.

appraisal.label: frustration
appraisal.cause: The rogue accuses the dealer without proof.

improv_read.player_bid: Wren grabs the dealer's wrist and accuses him of dealing from the bottom.
improv_read.connection: Uktarl cheats, but this time there is nothing to show.
improv_read.kit_choice: Kit lets the accusation fall flat so the table turns tense.

public_brief.objective: Turn an unproven accusation back on the accuser.
public_brief.tactic: Point out calmly that nothing was dealt, and warn her off with his crew behind him.
public_brief.visible_cue: The fresco-side player's hand drifts below the table edge.
public_brief.player_opening: She can let go, press for proof, or escalate.
public_brief.reply_to: That one came from the bottom. Turn the deck over.
public_brief.kit_focus: Freeze the moment on the held wrist, show there is no proof, and let the table close in.
public_brief.mirror: steady energy, standard, dry humor: the dealer answers with icy calm

segments.speaker: Narrator
segments.text: Her fingers close on his wrist and the fan of cards freezes in the air. Nothing falls loose; nothing on the table gives him away. Around the table the pale faces turn to her one by one, and the fresco-side player's hand drifts below the edge of the wood.

segments.speaker: Dealer
segments.text: The bottom, madam? I have not dealt a single card yet, as everyone at this table can tell you. You are holding a gentleman's wrist over an accusation you cannot show. I would let go, I think, before my friends here decide you mean it.

segments.speaker: Kit
segments.text: Every face is on you, and nothing proves it yet. What do you do?
segments.reacts_to: I would let go, I think
